shop-S01-accounts-lost.last_sql:
WITH anchor AS (
  SELECT max(opened_at) AS now_ts FROM shop.repair_order
),
cust AS (
  SELECT customer_id, name, price_class, payment_terms_days
  FROM shop.customer
  WHERE payment_terms_days IS NOT NULL
),
agg AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, c.name,
    max(o.opened_at) AS last_order_on,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.opened_at >= a.now_ts - interval '30 days')::int AS last_30,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.opened_at >= a.now_ts - interval '180 days'
                       AND o.opened_at <  a.now_ts - interval '150 days')::int AS d150_180
  FROM cust c
  CROSS JOIN anchor a
  LEFT JOIN shop.repair_order o
    ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status <> 'void'
  GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name, a.now_ts
)
SELECT name AS account_name,
       to_char(last_order_on,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS last_order_on_yyyy_mm_dd,
       last_30 AS orders_last_30_days_count,
       d150_180 AS orders_180_to_150_days_ago_count
FROM agg
WHERE (last_30 = 0 AND d150_180 > 0)      -- dropped off (churned)
   OR (last_30 > 0 AND last_30 < d150_180) -- losing now (frequency collapsing)
ORDER BY last_30 ASC, d150_180 DESC;

with te as (
 select t.technician_id, t.clock_in, date_trunc('month',t.clock_in) mon,
  extract(epoch from coalesce(t.clock_out,t.clock_in))-extract(epoch from t.clock_in) secs, ro.location_id
 from shop.time_entry t join shop.order_job oj using(order_job_id) join shop.repair_order ro on ro.repair_order_id=oj.repair_order_id)
select location_id, technician_id, round(sum(secs)/3600.0,2) clocked, min(clock_in) first_at, max(clock_in) last_at
from te where location_id=3 group by 1,2 order by clocked desc

shop-revenue-30d-by-shop.last_sql:
WITH first_inv AS (
  SELECT repair_order_id, min(changed_at) AS invoiced_at
  FROM shop.order_status_history
  WHERE status = 'invoiced'
  GROUP BY repair_order_id
)
SELECT l.name AS shop_name,
       count(*) AS orders,
       round(sum(o.total - o.tax_total), 2) AS rev_naive,
       round(sum(o.total - o.tax_total) FILTER (WHERE (fi.invoiced_at AT TIME ZONE l.time_zone) >= now() - interval '30 days'), 2) AS rev_tz
FROM shop.repair_order o
JOIN shop.location l ON l.location_id = o.location_id
JOIN first_inv fi ON fi.repair_order_id = o.repair_order_id
WHERE o.order_type = 'customer_pay'
  AND o.status IN ('invoiced', 'paid')
  AND fi.invoiced_at >= (now() - interval '30 days')::timestamp
GROUP BY l.name

shop-cars-per-day.last_sql:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT l.location_id, l.name, l.opened_on,
         o.opened_at::date AS d
  FROM shop.repair_order o
  JOIN shop.location l ON l.location_id = o.location_id
  WHERE o.status <> 'void'
), per_shop AS (
  SELECT location_id, name, opened_on,
         count(*) AS visits,
         (max(d) - min(d) + 1) AS days
  FROM v GROUP BY 1,2,3
)
SELECT name AS shop_name,
       round(count_visits::numeric / days, 2) AS cars_per_day_avg
FROM (SELECT location_id, name, opened_on, visits AS count_visits, days FROM per_shop) t
ORDER BY location_id

shop-recommended-sold-by-advisor.last_sql:
with rec as (
  select ro.advisor_id, j.status
  from shop.inspection_item ii
  join shop.inspection i on i.inspection_id = ii.inspection_id
  join shop.order_job j on j.order_job_id = ii.order_job_id
  join shop.repair_order ro on ro.repair_order_id = j.repair_order_id and ro.status <> 'void'
  join shop.location l on l.location_id = ro.location_id
  where (i.completed_at at time zone l.time_zone) >= now() - interval '90 days'
)
select e.first_name||' '||coalesce(e.middle_name||' ','')||e.last_name as advisor_name,
       count(*) as recommended_jobs_count,
       round(count(*) filter (where status='approved')::numeric / nullif(count(*) filter (where status in ('approved','declined')),0), 4) as sold_share_float_0_1
from rec
join shop.employee e on e.employee_id = rec.advisor_id
group by e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.middle_name, e.last_name
order by sold_share_float_0_1 desc

shop-tech-efficiency-this-month.last_sql:
with sold as (
  select ol.technician_id as tid, sum(ol.hours) as sold_hours
  from shop.order_labor ol
  join shop.order_job oj on oj.order_job_id = ol.order_job_id
  join shop.repair_order ro on ro.repair_order_id = oj.repair_order_id
  where oj.status = 'approved'
    and ro.status <> 'void'
    and ol.technician_id is not null
    and ro.opened_at >= '2026-11-01' and ro.opened_at < '2026-12-01'
  group by 1
), clocked as (
  select te.technician_id as tid,
         sum(extract(epoch from (coalesce(te.clock_out, te.clock_in) - te.clock_in))/3600.0) as clocked_hours
  from shop.time_entry te
  where te.clock_in >= '2026-11-01' and te.clock_in < '2026-12-01'
  group by 1
)
select e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name as technician_name,
       round(coalesce(s.sold_hours, 0), 2) as sold_hours,
       round(coalesce(c.clocked_hours, 0), 2) as clocked_hours,
       round(coalesce(s.sold_hours, 0)::numeric / nullif(c.clocked_hours, 0), 4) as sold_over_clocked_float
from sold s
full join clocked c on c.tid = s.tid
join shop.employee e on e.employee_id = coalesce(s.tid, c.tid)
order by sold_over_clocked_float desc nulls last

shop-account-revenue.last_sql:
WITH inv AS (
  SELECT ro.customer_id, ro.total - ro.tax_total AS rev, min(h.changed_at) AS invoiced_at
  FROM shop.repair_order ro
  JOIN shop.order_status_history h ON h.repair_order_id = ro.repair_order_id AND h.status='invoiced'
  WHERE ro.order_type='customer_pay' AND ro.status IN ('invoiced','paid')
  GROUP BY ro.repair_order_id, ro.customer_id, ro.total, ro.tax_total
)
SELECT c.name AS account_name,
       count(*) AS orders_count,
       round(sum(inv.rev),2) AS revenue_before_tax_rub
FROM inv
JOIN shop.customer c ON c.customer_id = inv.customer_id
WHERE c.kind = 'company'
  AND inv.invoiced_at >= timestamp '2025-11-15 00:00:00'   -- trailing 12 months, data as of 2026-11-15
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name
ORDER BY revenue_before_tax_rub DESC
LIMIT 1

shop-unpaid-orders.last_sql:
select o.number as order_number,
       l.name as shop_name,
       c.name as customer_name,
       round(o.total - coalesce((select sum(case when p.kind='refund' then -p.amount else p.amount end) from shop.payment p where p.repair_order_id=o.repair_order_id),0),2) as owed_rub,
       floor(extract(epoch from ((now() at time zone l.time_zone) - h.invoiced_at))/86400)::int as days_since_invoiced
from shop.repair_order o
join shop.customer c on c.customer_id=o.customer_id
join shop.location l on l.location_id=o.location_id
join lateral (select max(changed_at) as invoiced_at from shop.order_status_history x where x.repair_order_id=o.repair_order_id and x.status='invoiced') h on true
where o.status='invoiced' and c.kind<>'company'
order by days_since_invoiced desc, o.number

shop-discounts-this-month.last_sql:
SELECT repair_order_id, location_id, labor_total, parts_total, sublet_total, fees_total, discount_total, tax_total, total,
       round((labor_total+parts_total+sublet_total+fees_total - discount_total) - total, 2) AS total_check,
       round(total*0.05/1.05 - tax_total, 2) AS tax_check,
       round(discount_total/(labor_total+parts_total+sublet_total+fees_total),4) AS disc_share
FROM shop.repair_order
WHERE opened_at >= '2026-11-01' AND discount_total>0 AND order_type='customer_pay' AND status<>'void'
ORDER BY discount_total DESC LIMIT 6
